title: Cold rebuild: optional services with profiles
summary: Start a stack with and without its profiles and run a one-off job, on a real Docker Engine, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a skill stuck. In *env, volumes and profiles* you started a stack with an optional profile and ran a
one-off job, with real Docker Compose. Now do it again from memory: the same scenario, **no hints, no solution to
peek at**. The checks are exactly the ones you passed the first time.
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old commands feels like knowing
them; doing it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: `.env` contains `API_KEY=abc`. The compose file never mentions `API_KEY`. Does the api container see `API_KEY`?
options: No: `.env` only feeds `${...}` interpolation in the compose file
Yes: every container gets all variables from `.env`
steps.explain: To pass it in, write `environment: API_KEY: ${API_KEY}`, or put it in a file referenced by `env_file:`.
